definitions.full: H7867. sib שִׂיב verb be hoary (Late Hebrew שֵׂיבָה old age ; Assyrian šêbu , aged man ; Arabic () become hoary , Ethiopic (in derivatives); Aramaic סִיב be old ; grow old, grey hair ); — Qal Perfect 1singular וָשַׂ֫בְתִּי זָקַנְתִּי 1Sam 12:2 ; Participle שָׂב Job 15:10 (+ יָשִׁישׁ aged ).
